title: Performance Marketer
description:
Key Responsibilities

* Plan, launch and manage Meta Ads campaigns for domestic and international travel products.
* Manage campaign structure, audiences, budgets, placements and optimization.
* Monitor CPL, CTR, CPM, CPC, lead quality, conversion rate, CAC and ROAS.
* Identify which campaigns and creatives are generating qualified leads and bookings.
* Continuously test new creatives, hooks, offers, audiences and campaign structures.
* Work with the creative team to develop performance\-oriented ad creatives.
* Analyze campaign performance on a daily and weekly basis.
* Optimize budgets based on campaign and trip\-level performance.
* Identify underperforming campaigns and take corrective action quickly.
* Coordinate with the sales team to understand lead quality and booking conversion.
* Build proper tracking between advertising leads, CRM and confirmed bookings.
* Analyze the complete funnel from **Ad → Lead → Sales Follow\-up → Booking → Revenue**.
* Create weekly performance reports with clear insights and action points.
* Research competitors, market trends, audience behavior and new advertising opportunities.
* Help scale successful campaigns while maintaining profitability.
* Experiment with new acquisition channels when relevant.

What We Are Looking For

* 2–5 years of hands\-on performance marketing experience.
* Strong experience with **Meta Ads Manager**.
* Proven experience running lead\-generation campaigns.
* Strong understanding of campaign optimization and performance metrics.
* Comfortable working with numbers, spreadsheets and data.
* Understanding of conversion funnels and customer acquisition.
* Experience with CRM and lead tracking is a strong advantage.
* Ability to understand whether a campaign is actually contributing to revenue, not just leads.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of results.
* Fast learner who enjoys testing and experimenting.
* Good communication and coordination skills.

Preferred Experience

Experience in any of the following industries will be an advantage:

* Travel \& Tourism
* Hospitality
* E\-commerce
* Education
* Real Estate
* D2C
* Lead\-generation businesses

Experience with the following tools is a plus:

* Meta Ads Manager
* Google Ads
* Google Analytics
* Google Sheets / Excel
* CRM platforms
* WhatsApp marketing
* Conversion tracking
* Meta Pixel / Conversions API
* Looker Studio or similar reporting tools

Important

We are **not looking for someone who only knows how to run ads**.

We want someone who thinks like a business owner and asks:

**“How much did we spend, how many qualified leads did we get, how many bookings came from those leads, and how much revenue/profit did we generate?”**

You should be comfortable taking responsibility for performance and making decisions based on data.

Key Performance Indicators

Your performance will be evaluated based on:

* Qualified Leads
* Cost Per Lead
* Lead\-to\-Booking Conversion Rate
* Customer Acquisition Cost
* Revenue Generated
* ROAS
* Campaign Profitability
* Creative Performance
* Overall marketing efficiency

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

title: Assistant Manager, SAP ABAP
description:
**SAP ABAP Development**

	+ BAdIs and enhancement frameworks
	+ Function modules and classes
	+ BAPIs and RFC\-enabled objects
	+ Forms including Smart Forms and Adobe Forms
	+ Workflows where applicable
	+ Conversion and migration programs
	+ Background processing programs
* Perform object\-oriented ABAP development using appropriate SAP development standards.
* Review functional specifications and translate business requirements into technical designs and technical specifications.
* Prepare technical specifications with sufficient detail for development, testing, validation, and long\-term support.

**SAP S/4HANA \& Modern Development**

* Demonstrate hands\-on experience with SAP S/4HANA development concepts and technologies.
* Develop and optimize:
	+ Core Data Services ( **CDS Views** )
	+ ABAP Managed Database Procedures ( **AMDP** ) where appropriate
	+ OData services
	+ APIs and web services
	+ REST/SOAP\-based integrations
* Exposure to **ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP)** is preferred.
* Exposure to **SAP BTP ABAP Environment / ABAP Cloud** is advantageous.
* Understand S/4HANA data\-model simplification and ensure legacy ABAP programs are appropriately redesigned or optimized.
* Follow **Clean Core principles** , including preference for standard functionality, released APIs, extensibility frameworks, and side\-by\-side extensions where appropriate.
* Support SAP Fiori/UI5 applications from the ABAP backend and service\-development perspective.

**Interfaces \& Integration**

* Develop and support SAP interfaces with SAP and non\-SAP applications.
* Work with integration technologies including:
	+ IDoc/ALE
	+ RFC/BAPI
	+ OData
	+ REST/SOAP APIs
	+ Proxy/web services
	+ File\-based integrations
* Collaborate with middleware/integration teams working with platforms such as SAP Integration Suite/CPI or equivalent enterprise integration platforms.
* Implement appropriate interface monitoring, exception handling, reprocessing, logging, and reconciliation mechanisms.
* Ensure interface programs maintain appropriate transactional integrity and prevent duplicate or incomplete processing.

**Technical Quality \& Performance**

* Perform peer code reviews and ensure adherence to SAP development standards.
* Use **ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC)** and other SAP code\-quality tools to identify and remediate technical issues.
* Perform performance analysis and optimization using appropriate SAP tools.
* Ensure efficient database access and avoid performance\-intensive custom development.
* Follow secure coding standards and address identified vulnerabilities.
* Develop reusable objects and frameworks where technically and commercially appropriate.
* Support remediation of custom code during SAP upgrades, releases, and S/4HANA transformations.

**Pharmaceutical / GxP / CSV Responsibilities**

* Understand working expectations within a **regulated pharmaceutical or life\-sciences environment** .
* Follow applicable IT quality, change\-management, and validation procedures for GxP\-relevant SAP functionality.
* Support preparation and review of technical documentation required for **Computerized System Validation (CSV)** .
* Maintain appropriate traceability from approved functional requirements/specifications to technical developments and test evidence.
* Ensure GxP\-relevant developments include appropriate:
	+ Auditability
	+ Data integrity controls
	+ Error handling
	+ Authorization checks
	+ Electronic record considerations
	+ Logging and traceability
* Support QA/CSV teams during validation, defect resolution, release assessment, and audit activities.
* Ensure production changes are performed through approved change\-control and transport\-management processes.
* Support regulatory or internal audits by providing technical documentation and evidence when required.
* Awareness of **GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ALCOA\+ data\-integrity principles, and applicable GxP practices** is preferred.

**Testing \& Deployment**

* Perform developer/unit testing for all custom developments.
* Prepare appropriate unit\-test documentation and technical evidence.
* Analyse and resolve defects across development and test cycles.
* Support cutover, deployment, hyper care, and post\-go\-live activities.
* Follow appropriate SAP transport\-management procedures across development, quality, validation, and production environments.

**Production Support**

* Provide Level 2/Level 3 technical support for SAP ABAP\-related incidents and problems.
* Perform root\-cause analysis and implement permanent corrective solutions.
* Monitor and troubleshoot:
	+ Dumps
	+ Failed interfaces
	+ Background jobs
	+ Performance problems
	+ Workflow failures
	+ Application logs
* Participate in major\-incident resolution when SAP technical expertise is required.
* Maintain proper technical documentation for recurring issues and resolutions.

**Required Experience \& Skills**

* **8\+ years of hands\-on SAP ABAP development experience.**
* Strong hands\-on experience in core ABAP and object\-oriented ABAP.
* Practical experience with SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA environments.
* Strong experience in enhancements, interfaces, forms, reports, conversions, and workflows.
* Experience with CDS Views, OData, APIs, and modern S/4HANA development approaches.
* Good understanding of SAP functional processes and ability to work effectively with functional consultants.
* Strong debugging, troubleshooting, performance\-tuning, and root\-cause\-analysis skills.
* Experience working through complete SAP implementation and/or major transformation lifecycle preferred.
* Experience working in geographically distributed or global teams.
* Candidates from either **SAP service/consulting companies or product/end\-user organizations** are acceptable, provided they demonstrate strong hands\-on technical capability.

  
* Pharmaceutical, life\-sciences, medical\-device, or other regulated\-industry experience.
* Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA greenfield or brownfield implementation.
* Knowledge of SAP BTP, ABAP Cloud, RAP, Fiori and SAP Integration Suite.
* Experience with SAP Cloud ALM, Solution Manager, ChaRM, or equivalent lifecycle/change\-management platforms.
* Experience working with formal SDLC, ITIL, CSV, GxP, and change\-control processes.
* Exposure to SAP security concepts and authorization checks within custom developments.
* SAP ABAP/S/4HANA/BTP\-related certification preferred.

title: Premier Service manager
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**


If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Business Descriptor**


Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6\.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day\-to\-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

 **Job Introduction**


The Premier Service Manager (PSM) role is a pivotal position within the International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) branch network. IWPB is executing a multiyear growth strategy, pivoted on positioning as a global bank, committed to the long\-term India growth story, and bringing to India its full scale of global capabilities. The business is poised for growth and is currently adding 20 more branches in phases to its existing fleet of 26 branches. This role is customer\-facing, primarily servicing walk\-in customers and managing their requirements to ensure satisfaction. The Premier proposition is a strategic priority for HSBC, and this role supports the Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) in achieving their objectives by enhancing client\-facing time and providing outstanding customer experiences.

**Principal Responsibilities**

* Provide high\-quality support to a team of Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) to achieve income plans through acquisition, cross\-sales, retention, and growth.
* Act as the first point of contact for clients in the absence of PRMs, ensuring seamless service and relationship management.
* Build extensive knowledge of HSBC systems and procedures to effectively handle client needs and improve process efficiencies.
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance customer service and process efficiencies.
* Ensure clients consistently receive professional, premium service that exceeds expectations.
* Maintain high standards of control and operational practices in line with HSBC’s expectations.
* Enhance customer confidence in HSBC’s Global Premier proposition through systematic and regular communication.
* Attain key performance indicators (KPIs) by acquiring new customers and promoting credit card and general insurance products.
* Meet KPIs for referrals and cross\-selling opportunities.

**Education Qualifications / Certifications and Requirements**

* Graduate Degree
* Minimum of two to five years of experience in a customer service or banking environment.
* Holistic understanding of branch operations and processes.
* Sound understanding of the company’s customer service requirements.

**Other Requirements (Knowledge and Experience)**

* Exceptional and updated knowledge of banking products, systems, and processes.
* Well\-organized with a professional image and extraordinary business focus.
* Strong customer orientation and ability to provide exemplary service.
* Self\-motivated with the drive to overachieve on goals and targets.
* Ability to build close relationships with team members and skillful association with support group colleagues.

**Skills**

* **Exceptional Communication Skills:** Ability to convey information clearly and effectively across various channels.
* **Strong Interpersonal Skills:** Capable of building and maintaining positive relationships with colleagues and clients.
* **Highly Organized:** Demonstrates meticulous attention to detail and efficient task management.
* **Collaborative Team Player:** Works well within a team, contributing to collective goals and fostering a supportive environment.
* **Proactive and Efficient:** Acts swiftly and decisively to achieve objectives, ensuring timely completion of tasks.

**Regulatory Certifications:**


FEDAI, NISM (Demat), and IRDA certifications are preferred or should be obtained / transferred to HSBC mapping within 3 to 6 months of onboarding

  

Pro\-tip : Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.

  



*As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.*

  

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

  

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.


Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
